name: Oven (fan)
why: Roasts, bakes, tray dinners. Recipes give fan temperatures.

name: Hob
why: Everything in a pan.

name: Blender
why: Pesto, romesco, soups, smoothies.

name: Stick (hand) blender
why: Blend soups and fix lumpy sauces in the pan; aioli in a jar.

name: Stand / hand mixer
why: Whipping cream and egg whites, doughs.

name: Slow cooker
why: Tough cuts, stock, meal-prep batches while you are out.

name: Air fryer
why: Crispy chicken, salmon, halloumi and veg with little oil, fast.

name: Food processor
why: Chopping and grating in bulk, cauliflower rice in seconds.

name: Stainless sauté pan 28 cm with lid
why: Searing and pan sauces — builds the brown fond non-stick never does.

name: Small heavy saucepan
why: Béchamel, hollandaise bain-marie, reductions.

name: Cast-iron skillet
why: Holds heat for the best steak crust; goes in the oven.

name: Non-stick frying pan
why: Eggs, omelettes, delicate fish.

name: Stock pot (6–8 L)
why: Stock, pasta, big batches.

name: Roasting tray
why: Roasts, tray bakes, slow braises.

name: Oven dish (glass/ceramic)
why: Moussaka, parmigiana, gratins.

name: Chef's knife 20 cm + steel
why: The one knife for nearly everything; the steel keeps the edge aligned.

name: Paring knife
why: Small jobs, peeling, trimming.

name: Chopping boards ×2 (meat / veg)
why: Separate raw meat from veg to avoid cross-contamination.

name: Balloon whisk + flat whisk
why: Emulsions, roux sauces; the flat whisk reaches pan corners.

name: Silicone spatula
why: Scraping every bit of sauce; heat-proof.

name: Tongs
why: Turning meat without piercing it.

name: Fish slice
why: Flipping fish and eggs in one piece.

name: Ladle
why: Stock into risotto, soup into bowls.

name: Fine sieve
why: Smooth sauces, straining stock.

name: Colander
why: Draining pasta and veg.

name: Microplane grater
why: Lemon zest, parmesan, frozen ginger, nutmeg.

name: Peeler
why: Carrots, potatoes, ribbons of courgette.

name: Measuring spoons & jug
why: Recipes in tsp/tbsp/ml come out the same every time.

name: Digital scale (1 g)
why: Grams make macros and sauces accurate.

name: Instant-read thermometer
why: Ends guessing: chicken 74 °C, steak 54–57 °C.

name: Oven probe thermometer
why: Stays in the roast and beeps at the right temperature.

name: Mixing bowls
why: Mise en place, marinating, bain-marie.

name: Glass meal-prep containers
why: Prep batches; oven- and microwave-safe.

name: Baking paper & foil
why: Foil parcels, resting meat, easy trays.

name: Mortar & pestle
why: Crushing coriander seed, garlic, peppercorns.
